piezas.titulo: Written production: Schedules, appointments and weekly routine
texto: Guided writing: write a short paragraph about a weekly routine (Intermediate level). Write three or four simple, connected sentences describing a future plan and a completed task. Use: 1) Time markers («พรุ่งนี้», «ตอนเช้า»). 2) Plan particle («จะ»). 3) Completion particle («เสร็จแล้ว»). Check that your pronouns are consistent.
